About me
Driven by a childhood
curiosity of asking "why."

I am a multilingual marcom and content strategist with over 10 years of international experience, helping B2B and tech-focused organizations create and manage strategic content designed to attract and engage the right people.

With a career spanning SaaS, retail, and, for the past five years, deep tech and quantum technology, I've worked both in-house and freelance at shiny new startups and bigger-sized organizations. I've simplified complex topics such as quantum technology, cryogenics and superconducting systems, written think pieces, featured articles and thought leadership interviews, building social media, SEO and tone of voice strategies from the ground up.

In environments filled with complex jargon, I aim to create clarity — crafting content that resonates, that tells a story, and is truly human. I've collaborated with international research institutions, founders, government bodies, policymakers and industry ecosystems to improve positioning, visibility and stakeholder alignment across Europe.

"The whole is greater than the sum of its parts." — Aristotle

At heart I'm a collaborative and pragmatic person who believes in showing up with resilience when things get messy. I care deeply about trust, transparency and shared accountability, and I do my best work in cross-functional environments where complex challenges require collective thinking and strategic focus.

Originally from Bologna, Italy, I've lived in five different countries across Europe and now happily call Brussels home — the place where innovation, tech policy and strategy intersect in the most dynamic way.
